custom_field: প্রতি প্রশ্নের মান ১ ও ভুল উত্তরের জন্য ০.২৫ কাটা যাবে

Bank English Preparation.question: ১) I wouldn't worry if __________.
Bank English Preparation.exp:
Second Conditionals এর নিয়মানুযায়ী, 
- If যুক্ত clause টিতে Past Simple tense থাকলে, অপর clause টি Future in Past (S + would/might/could + Base Form of the Verb) হয়। 
- Structure: If + past simple >> + would + infinitive.

Examples: 
- If we had a garden, we could have a cat.
- If I won a lot of money, I'd buy a big house in the country.
- I wouldn't worry if I were you.

উল্লেখ্য, If এর পর যদি be verb থাকে, তাহলে 'were' ব্যবহার করা Grammatically correct.

Bank English Preparation.question: ২) He had better ________ a helmet while riding his bike for safety.
Bank English Preparation.exp:
• Had better এর ক্ষেত্রে:
- Had better অর্থ তবুও/ বরং ভালো।
- Had better যুক্ত sentence past tense এর হলেও তা মূলত past tense নয়।
- Had better- unreal past ইহা present/ future tense এর অর্থ প্রকাশ করে
- Had better এর পর infinitive to বসে না।
- সর্বদা verb এর base form বসে।

Examples: 
- You had better study hard if you want to pass the exam.
- We had better leave now if we want to catch the train on time.
- She had better apologize for her behavior.

Complete Sentence - He had better wear a helmet while riding his bike for safety.

Bank English Preparation.question: ৩) Had I known in advance, I ______ enough money.
Bank English Preparation.exp:
• Third conditional এর নিয়মানুযায়ী - 
- অনেকসময় conditional-এ subordinate conjunction if এর পরিবর্তে sentence এর শুরুতে Had ব্যবহার করা যায় এবং এর পর verb এর past participle form বসে।
- Conditional sentence- এ Had + Sub + V3 + Ext. এভাবে কোন Sentence শুরু হলে সেটিও Perfect conditional/ 3rd conditional হয়।
- তাই পরবর্তী clause এ would/could/might + have + V3 + extension ব্যবহৃত হয়।

Examples:
- Had I seen him, I would have told him the matter.
- If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.

Complete sentence: Had I known in advance, I would have taken enough money.

Source: Advanced Learner's English Grammar & Composition by Chowdhury & Hossain.

Bank English Preparation.question: ৪) He spoke as though _____________.
Bank English Preparation.option2: he had known all the answers
Bank English Preparation.exp:
• As if/as though (conjunction) এর ব্যবহার: 
- as if/as though এর পূর্বে present indefinite tense থাকলে as if/as though এর পরে past indefinite হয়।
- be verb থাকলে সবসময় were হয়।

Example: He speaks as if he were mad.

• আবার, as if/as though এর পূর্বে Past indefinite tense থাকলে as if/as though এর পরে past perfect হয়।
Example: He spoke as though he had been mad.

তাই, Complete Sentence - He spoke as though he had known all the answers.

Bank English Preparation.question: ৫) Which of the following sentence constructions is correct?
Bank English Preparation.option1: Would that the weather could be sunny for our picnic.
Bank English Preparation.option2: Would that the weather could sunny for our picnic.
Bank English Preparation.option3: Would that the weather could have been sunny for our picnic.
Bank English Preparation.option4: Would that the weather being sunny for our picnic?
Bank English Preparation.exp:
• Would that এর ব্যবহার: 
- Sentence এর শুরুতে would that থাকলে subject এর পরে could বসে এবং প্রদত্ত verb এর present form বসে। 
- অবাস্তব ইচ্ছা বা সম্ভাবনা প্রকাশে Would that ব্যবহৃত হয়। 

Examples: 
- Would that I could go back in time and undo my mistakes.
- Would that she could see how much I care for her. 

Complete Sentence - Would that the weather could be sunny for our picnic. 

Source: Advanced Learner's Communicative English by Chowdhury & Hossain.

Bank English Preparation.question:
৬) The author dedicated his new book to his wife. </br> 
What is the passive voice form of the above sentence?
Bank English Preparation.option1: His wife was dedicated the new book to by the author.
Bank English Preparation.option2: The new book was dedicated to his wife by the author.
Bank English Preparation.option3: To his wife was dedicated the new book by the author.
Bank English Preparation.option4: His new book was dedicated to his wife by the author.
Bank English Preparation.exp:
Double object যুক্ত Active Voice কে Passive Voice এ রূপান্তরের নিয়ম: 
1) দুটি object এর যেকোন একটিকে passive voice এর subject করতে হয় (তবে ব্যক্তিবাচক অর্থাৎ Indirect object- কে subject করাই শ্রেয়) + 
2) Tense অনুযায়ী Auxiliary verb বসে + 
3) প্রদত্ত মূল verb এর Past Participle বসে + 
4) প্রদত্ত বাকী object টি বসে + 
5) by বসে + 
6) প্রদত্ত active voice এর subject টি object রূপে বসে।

Examples - 
Active: He won't give you any chance.
Passive: You won't be given any chance by him.

Active: The company offered the new employees excellent benefits.
Passive: Excellent benefits were offered to the new employees by the company.

Active: The jeweler promised the bride a beautiful ring.
Passive: A beautiful ring was promised to the bride by the jeweler.

So, the correct passive form - His new book was dedicated to his wife by the author.

Bank English Preparation.question: ৭) People say that good things come to those who wait. (Make it passive)
Bank English Preparation.option1: Good things are said to come to those who wait.
Bank English Preparation.option2: Those who wait are said to have good things come to them.
Bank English Preparation.option3: People said that good things come to those who wait.
Bank English Preparation.option4: It is said that good things come to those who wait.
Bank English Preparation.exp:
• Compound Sentence এবং Complex Sentence-এর ক্ষেত্রে Active voice-এর উভয় clause-কে একই voice-এ রূপান্তর করতে হয়।
- Active Voice People say দিয়ে শুরু হলে passive voice It is said দিয়ে শুরু করা হয়।

• Active voice এ people + stative verb (know, think, understand, know, find, say, etc) + that + clause থাকলে, passive করার নিয়ম হচ্ছে - 
- It is /was (tense অনুযায়ী) + said + that + clause (যা আছে তাই) টি।

সুতরাং, নিয়মানুযায়ী, 
Active: People say that good things come to those who wait.
Passive: It is said that good things come to those who wait.

Bank English Preparation.question: ৮) Water the plants daily. (Change the voice)
Bank English Preparation.option2: Let daily the plants be watered.
Bank English Preparation.option3: Let the plants be watered daily.
Bank English Preparation.option4: Let the plants daily be watered.
Bank English Preparation.exp:
• শুধু মূল verb দিয়ে শুরু হওয়া Imperative sentence এর Active voice থেকে passive করার নিয়ম:
- প্রথমে Let বসবে;
- Active voice এর object টির subject রূপে বসবে;
- be বসবে;
- মূল verb এর past participle বসবে।

Structure: Let + object টির subject হয় + be + মূল verb এর past participle + extensions. 

Active: Water the plants daily. 
Passive: Let the plants be watered daily.

Source: Advanced Learner's HSC by Chowdhury & Hossain.

Bank English Preparation.question:
৯) The construction workers built a new shopping mall in the city center within six months. </br> 
Which of the following correctly transforms the active sentence into a passive voice?
Bank English Preparation.option1: A new shopping mall was building in the city center within six months.
Bank English Preparation.option2: A new shopping mall was built in the city center within six months.
Bank English Preparation.option3: A new shopping mall was building by the construction workers in the city center within six months.
Bank English Preparation.option4: A new shopping mall was being built in the city center within six months.
Bank English Preparation.exp:
• Past Indefinite Tense এর Active voice কে Passive voice এ রূপান্তর করার নিয়ম: 
- Object টির subject form +
- was/were +
- মূল verb এর past participle +
- by +
- subject টির objective form বসে।

Active: The construction workers built a new shopping mall in the city center within six months.
Passive: A new shopping mall was built in the city center within six months (by the construction workers).

Source: Advanced Learner's Communicative English by Chowdhury & Hossain.

Bank English Preparation.question: ১০) I heard her singing in the shower. (Make it passive)
Bank English Preparation.option1: She was heard by singing in the shower.
Bank English Preparation.option2: Singing in the shower was heard by her.
Bank English Preparation.option3: Her singing in the shower is heard by me.
Bank English Preparation.option4: Her singing in the shower was heard by me.
Bank English Preparation.exp:
• Make, need, dare, bare, hear, feel, know ইত্যাদি causative verb গুলোর পর active voice এ bare infinitive হয় অর্থাৎ to উহ্য থাকে। 
কিন্তু passive এ পরিবর্তন করবার সময় তাদের পর to বসাতে হয়। 

• Causative verb যুক্ত বাক্যটির passive voice- এর structure: 
- Object কে  Sub + Auxiliary verb + Causative verb - এর Past Participle + to +  মুল verb + by + Sub কে Object.

Active: I heard her singing in the shower.
Passive: Her singing in the shower was heard by me.

Bank English Preparation.question: ১১) Which word is similar to 'Yield'?
Bank English Preparation.exp:
Yield (verb-transitive), (verb intransitive) 
English Meaning: 1. (Of a substance) soft and easy to bend or move when you press it.
2. (of a person) willing to do what other people want.
Bangla Meaning: 
(১) প্রাকৃতিক রীতিতে উৎপাদন করা বা উৎপন্ন হওয়া: trees yield us fruits. Diligence yields good results; high-yielding seeds.
(২) yield (to somebody/something) আত্মসমর্পণ করা; বিরোধিতা করা থেকে বিরত হওয়া: I shall not yield to your temptation. The miscreants yielded to strong measures.

• Synonyms: Surrender (বশ্যতা স্বীকার করা), Produce, (প্রদান করা), Return (অনুগত), Slavish (দাস সুলভ), Gentle (কমনীয়)। 
• Antonyms: Hard (কঠোর), Resistant (বাধা প্রদানকারী), Rigid (দৃঢ়), Strict (কঠোর), Determined (নির্ধারিত)। 

Other Forms:
- yielding (adjective) সহজেই অবনত হয় বা বক্র হয় এমন; (লাক্ষণিক) একরোখা নয় এমন।
- yieldingly (adverb)

Example Sentence: 
1. I know not which is most injurious to the yielding minds of the young.
2. It may, however, yield a more sequent conclusion if one minor change in the text is made.

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Bank English Preparation.question: ১২) Antonym of the word 'Zenith' is -
Bank English Preparation.exp:
Zenith (noun): 
English Meaning - The best or most successful point or time. 
Bangla Meaning - সুবিন্দু; খমধ্য; পরাকাষ্ঠা; চরম অবস্থা; পরম অবস্থা; সর্বোচ্চ স্থান; পরমোন্নতি। 

অপশনসমূহ, 
Summit - চূড়া, শীর্ষ; 
Crux - জটিল সমস্যা; মূল কথা; আসল ব্যাপার; কঠিন সমস্যা; বিতর্কের মূল বিষয়;
Nadir - সর্বনিম্ন, অধোবিন্দু; 
Pinnacle - শৃঙ্গ. চূড়া। 

অপশনসমূহ বিবেচনা করে দেখা যায়, সঠিক উত্তরটি হচ্ছে - Nadir.

Bank English Preparation.question: ১৩) Select the correctly spelled word.
Bank English Preparation.exp:
• Adolescence (noun): 
English Meaning: Stage of growth between boyhood and youth
Bangla Meaning: শৈশব ও যৌবনের মধ্যবর্তী কাল; বয়ঃসন্ধি; কৈশোর; এই সময়কার প্রবৃদ্ধি।

Example Sentences: 
- Many memories from my adolescence still remain vivid in my mind.
- She fondly reminisces about the friendships she formed during her adolescence.

Source: Cambridge Dictionary.

Bank English Preparation.question:
১৪) Stop <u>beating about the bush</u> and just tell me what happened! </br> 
The underlined part means -
Bank English Preparation.option1: To defeat an opponent with ease.
Bank English Preparation.option3: To avoid discussing the main topic.
Bank English Preparation.option4: To be impossible to believe or describe.
Bank English Preparation.exp:
Beat about the bush:
English Meaning: To discuss a matter without coming to the point.
- In other words: means to avoid discussing the main topic or issue, and instead talk about irrelevant or unrelated things.
- It refers to someone who is not getting to the point or being straightforward in their communication.

Bangla Meaning: ঘুরিয়ে কোথা বলা / পরোক্ষভাবে বলা। 

Ex. Sentence: Quit beating around the bush and say what you want.
Bangla Meaning: ঘুরিয়ে পেঁচিয়ে না বলে কী চাও সরাসরি বলো।

Source: Live MCQ Lecture

Bank English Preparation.question: ১৫) LOGIC : REASONING ::
Bank English Preparation.exp:
Logic (noun) - যুক্তিবিদ্যা;
Reasoning (noun) - যুক্তিবৃত্তির মাধ্যমে সিদ্ধান্তে উপনীত হওয়ার প্রক্রিয়া; যুক্তিবিন্যাস; যুক্তিপাত।

সম্পর্ক: যুক্তিবিদ্যায় বিভিন্ন যুক্তিবিন্যাস সম্পর্কে আলোচনা করা হয়।

অপশনসমূহ,
Sensitivity - অনুভবশক্তি; Morality - নৈতিকতা।
Ethics - নীতিবিদ্যা; Behavior - আচরণ।
Creativity - সৃজনশীলতা; Enthusiasm - প্রবল উৎসাহ।
Bravery - সাহসিকতা; Charisma - ঐশ্বরিক করুণা; আধ্যাত্মিক শক্তি, সৌন্দর্য বা মহিমা।

অপশনসমূহ বিবেচনা করে দেখা যায়,
Ethics : Behavior সঠিক, কেননা নীতিবিদ্যায় মানুষের আচার-আচরণ নিয়ে আলোচনা করা হয়।

Source: Accessible Dictionary by Bangla Academy.

Bank English Preparation.question: ১৬) An extreme fear of heights -
Bank English Preparation.exp:
Acrophobia: 
English Meaning - Extreme or irrational fear of heights. 
Bengali Meaning - উচ্চতা - ভীতি। 

Other options, 
Aerophobia - The fear of traveling in an aircraft. 
Androphobia - Fear of men. 
Emetophobia - Extreme fear of vomiting or of seeing other people vomit. 

Source: Cambridge Dictionary and Live MCQ Lecture.

Bank English Preparation.question: ১৭) She is ______ a state of depression.
Bank English Preparation.exp:
• অবস্থা বা মানসিক অবস্থা বুঝাতে preposition হিসেবে 'in' ব্যবহৃত হয়। 
যেমন: 
- The baby is in a deep sleep.
- They are in debt.
- He is in pain after the accident.
- She is in a state of confusion. 

তাই, Complete Sentence - She is in a state of depression. (সে অবসাদগ্রস্ত।) 

• আরো কিছু ক্ষেত্রে Preposition হিসেবে 'in' এর ব্যবহার: 
1. অবস্থানের ক্ষেত্রে ভিতরে বা মধ্যে বোঝাতে in বসে।
যেমন: My pen was in the drawer. We are in the class.

2. সপ্তাহ, মাস, ঋতু, বছর, শতাব্দী ও সহস্রাব্দের পূর্বে in বসে।
যেমন: We will go in March. She likes to travel in winter. In the first week.

3. স্থানের ক্ষেত্রে বড়ো স্থানের পূর্বে in বসে।
যেমন: Bangladesh is a country in Asia. He lives in Dhaka.

4. কোনো পাঠ্য বা গবেষণার বিষয়ের পূর্বে in বসে।
যেমন: He studies in physics. She completed masters in economics.

5. পরিধান করে আছে এমন বোঝাতে in বসে।
যেমন: The boy in blue shirt is my friend. She was in jeans.

Source: 
1. Cambridge Dictionary. 
2. Live MCQ Lecture.

Bank English Preparation.question: ১৮) PREEMPT : PRECEDENCE ::
Bank English Preparation.exp:
Preempt (verb): 
Meaning - অগ্রক্রয়াধিকার বলে পাওয়া।

Precedence (noun): 
Meaning - অগ্রপদ বা অগ্রবর্তিতার অধিকার; অগ্রাধিকার; অগ্রগণ্যতা। 

সম্পর্ক: Precedence এর ভিত্তিতে পাওয়াকে Preempt বলে। 

অপশনসমুহ, 
dissemble - ছদ্মবেশ ধারণ করা; diplomacy - কূটনীতি। 
superintend - (কাজকর্মে) অবেক্ষণ ও পরিচালনা করা; culpability - শাস্তিযোগ্যতা।
preside - সভাপতিত্ব/পৌরোহিত্য করা; arbitration - মধ্যস্থতা। 
acquire - অর্জন করা; possession - স্বামিত্ব; স্বত্ব; অধিকার; দখল; আয়ত্ত। 

অপশনসমূহ বিবেচনা করে দেখা যায়, সঠিক উত্তরটি হচ্ছে acquire : possession. 
- কেননা, possession এর ভিত্তিতে পাওয়াকে acquire বলে। 

Source: Accessible Dictionary by Bangla Academy.

Bank English Preparation.question: ১৯) Choose the correct spelling.
Bank English Preparation.exp:
Caterpillar (noun): 
English Meaning - A small, long animal with many legs that feeds on the leaves of plants, and develops into a butterfly or moth. 
Bangla Meaning - শুঁয়া পোকা।

Example Sentences:
- All plants were checked for the presence of caterpillars and/or damaged leaves.
- Lizards attacked far fewer sawfly larvae than pierid caterpillars.

Source: Cambridge Dictionary.

Bank English Preparation.question: ২০) The idiom 'Steal a march on someone' means -
Bank English Preparation.option1: To gain an unfair advantage over someone.
Bank English Preparation.option2: To march ahead of someone in a military parade.
Bank English Preparation.option4: To take someone's place in a line or queue.
Bank English Preparation.exp:
Steal a march on someone (idiom): 
English Meaning - If you steal a march on someone, you get an advantage over that person by acting before they do. 
Bangla Meaning - (কারো উপর) গোপনে টেক্কা দিয়ে সুবিধালাভ করা।

Example Sentences: 
- Our rival company managed to steal a march on us by bringing out their software ahead of ours.
- The new restaurant was able to steal a march on its rivals by opening a few weeks earlier than planned.

Source: Cambridge Dictionary.
